title: SAGIP PHYSICAL STORE-CARRY-FORWARD FIELD ACCEPTANCE SEQUENCE
subtitle: This is the required end-to-end acceptance path from the canonical physical testing runbook.

messages.label: Create SOS and durably commit local state
messages.note: Internet is unavailable. Local persistence succeeds first.

messages.label: Transfer immutable SGP1 envelope over BLE
messages.note: SGC1 chunks carry the persisted origin envelope.

messages.label: Return durable custody acknowledgement
messages.note: Phone B persists the complete valid envelope before ACK.

messages.label: Later obtain internet and submit the same envelope
messages.note: Phone A and Phone B may already be separated.

messages.label: Expose accepted incident to authenticated responder
messages.note: Server acceptance is not yet responder acknowledgement.

messages.label: Gateway polls and stores responder acknowledgement
messages.note: Gateway-held ACK remains separate from Phone B's own civilian reports.

messages.label: Return SGA1 responder ACK over physical BLE
messages.note: Phones meet again after the gateway has stored the ACK.

messages.label: Durably record and display responder acknowledgement
messages.note: Only after valid local persistence may Phone A show responder acknowledgement.

acceptance_status.label: CURRENT EVIDENCE: COMPLETE TWO-PHYSICAL-PHONE LOOP REMAINS PENDING FIELD VALIDATION
